title: The British School in Colombo – Server Room Rack Neatening & Cable Management

date.notes: Project year confirmed by the owner; exact project date has not been recorded.

summary: Server-room network rack reorganization and cable-management work carried out at The British School in Colombo. The scope focused on neatening the existing rack, reorganizing patch cords, improving cable routing and arranging existing rack equipment in a more orderly and serviceable layout without changing the network design.
problem: The existing server-room network rack had congested and disorganized cabling that required cleanup and better cable routing and organization.
scope: Reorganization of existing network connections without redesigning the network
outcome: The existing rack and patching were reorganized into a substantially cleaner and more orderly layout, improving physical serviceability and cable organization.
evo_role: Server-room network rack neatening, patch-cord reorganization and cable management only.

website.short_description: Reorganization and cable-management work for an existing server-room network rack at The British School in Colombo, improving rack layout, patch-cord routing and overall serviceability without altering the existing network design.

media.description: Server-room network rack before cleanup, showing congested and loosely routed patch cords and cabling.
Server-room network rack after reorganization, showing improved cable routing and use of horizontal cable-management covers.

confirmed_by_owner: The project was completed at The British School in Colombo in 2026.
The owner's scope was rack neatening and cable management in the server room.
The work included organizing existing patch cords, cable routing and rack layout.
Firewall replacement and the five Starlink connections were not part of the owner's scope.
photo_observations: The before photo shows a rack with congested and loosely routed copper/fiber patching and cabling.
The after photo shows a substantially cleaner rack layout with horizontal cable-management covers and more orderly cable routing.
Rack-mounted patch panels and network switching equipment are visible in both photos.
needs_confirmation: Permission to publish the client name and project photos on the public EVO website.
do_not_claim: Do not claim firewall replacement, firewall configuration or firewall integration as part of this project's scope.
Do not claim installation, configuration or integration of the five Starlink connections as part of this project's scope.
Do not claim a full network redesign or network architecture change.
Do not infer exact switch, firewall or cabling models unless separately confirmed.
